questions.question: In a class of $140$ students numbered $1$ to$140$ , all even numbered students opted Mathematics course, those whose number is divisible by $3$ opted Physics course and those whose number is divisible by $5$ opted Chemistry course. Then the number of students who did not opt for any of the three courses is:
questions.explanation: From the given $140$ students, all even numbered students opted Mathematics $\left(M\right),$ hence, the number of students opted Mathematics is $M \equiv \left(\frac{140}{2}\right) = 70,$ where $\left(x\right)$ denotes the greatest integer function of $x.$ Similarly, the students who opted Physics are $P \equiv \left(\frac{140}{3}\right) = 46$ And, the students who opted Chemistry are $C \equiv \left(\frac{140}{5}\right) = 28$ Similarly, the students who opted Mathematics and Physics are the numbers which are divisible by both $2 & 3$ i.e. $6,$ and their number is $\left(\frac{140}{6}\right) = 23$ The students who opted Mathematics and Chemistry are the numbers which are divisible by both $2 & 5$ i.e. $10,$ and their number is $\left(\frac{140}{10}\right) = 14$ The students who opted Physics and Chemistry are the numbers which are divisible by both $3 & 5$ i.e. $15,$ and their number is $\left(\frac{140}{15}\right) = 9$ And, the students who opted all the three subjects are the numbers which are divisible by $2,3 & 5$ i.e. $30,$ and their number is $\left(\frac{140}{30}\right) = 4$ Now, using $n\left(P \cup C \cup M\right) = n\left(P\right) + n\left(C\right) + n\left(M\right) - n\left(P \cap C\right) - n\left(C \cap M\right) - n\left(M \cap P\right) + n\left(P \cap M \cap C\right) = 46 + 28 + 70 - 9 - 14 - 23 + 4 = 102$ Thus, $102$ students have opted for atleast one of the three subjects. Hence, number of students who did not opt for any of the three courses $= 140 - 102 = 38.$

Let $A,B$ and $C$ denote the set of men who received medals in even $A$, event $B$ and event $C$ respectively.

Then, $n\left(A\right) = 48,n\left(B\right) = 25,n\left(C\right) = 18$ , $n\left(A \cup B \cup C\right) = 60$ and $n\left(A \cap B \cap C\right) = 5$,
